name: ExplodedView
summary: Each left-hand pinch pushes a polyhedron's faces apart along their normals, so a hand ray can reach faces that were hidden or crowded.
howItWorks: Faces move out and rotate slightly while keeping their order; selection uses the hand ray. Tested with 16 participants selecting single faces on regular polyhedra (4, 6 or 12 faces, two sizes) with tracked hands.

relationships.note: Introduced with seven other face-selection techniques in the same study.
The study's baseline (DragRotate) rotates the object with one hand and selects with a hand ray.
